breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained both contradictory instructions: 'The k-point grid must be gamma-centered' and 'The k-point grid must have a half shift.' The ground truth resolved this by removing the gamma-centered requirement and keeping only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent failed to eliminate the conflicting gamma-centered instruction.
